in_campaign_success_bytes.decision: left counting every retained artifact in full; the difference is stated on artifact.RetainedBytes
reasons: campaign.json records retained_success_bytes; validateCampaign requires it to equal the sum of the executions' success_artifact_bytes and to stay within artifacts.success_bytes of the same record, and validateResumeExecutions holds the same sum to the plan's success_bytes_limit

counting a shared target once makes that recorded sum either a different number for the same campaign (campaign.json bytes change, and with them the campaign_sha256 a merged record binds) or a number above its recorded limit, which every reader of gomad3.campaign/v1 rejects

neither the campaign record nor an execution record names the target's size or says whether an artifact links to the pool or fell back to a private copy, so a record-only validator cannot recompute the bound
the retention decision and Store.MaximumBytes are fixed before publication, and whether the target was linked is known only after it
